newsitem.title: FRANCE: Spain's 1997 maize area seen rising by 4.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain's 1997 maize area seen rising by 4.6 pct.

text.p: Spain's maize area is expected to rise by 4.6 percent to 455,000 hectares in 1997 from 435,000 ha in 1996, the French maize growers association AGPM said in its May report.
The AGPM said the prediction was based on data from the French Embassy in Madrid.
Sowings on irrigated land were expected to rise by 4.9 percent to 388,000 ha and sowings on non-irrigated land by three percent to 67,000 ha.
Irrigated land represented 85.3 percent of total maize area in 1996 against 58.4 percent in 1995, when Spain was hit by severe drought.
Spain's maize output jumped to 3.6 million tonnes in 1996/97 from 2.4 million in 1995/96, helped by a development in irrigated area and strong yields.
Maize yields reached 8.3 tonnes per hectare in 1996/97, compared with the last five year average of 6.7 tonnes.
